title: chore(packages): migrate `algoliasearch-helper` to monorepo
body:
<!--

**Summary**

This PR integrates algoliasearch-helper into the InstantSearch monorepo.

It is now located in `packages/algoliasearch-helper`, and other packages in the monorepo will depend on it.

> **Note**
>
> Relevant changes are visible in [these 2 commits](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/pull/5703/files/c2c01e2ec675fd18f118b9904399af7695e4662d..e6defd3d8cf27c04e7178b8993d608bd518bdc99#diff-f9251a68200ee16e83bc8cba38df748f4d00d4772c21d21a2dc8ce356b4338a7).
